author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to create professional motion graphics with Claude AI step by step. In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to use Claude Design to build animations from simple prompts, refine them using natural language, and even generate motion graphics that synchronize with your existing video narration.

We’ll start by creating a branded title animation from scratch. Then, I’ll show you how to iterate on your design with simple prompts to make it look more polished and professional.

Next, we’ll take things further by uploading an SRT transcript along with brand assets so Claude Design can create motion graphics that match the timing and content of an existing video. Finally, I’ll export the animation as an MP4 and bring it into DaVinci Resolve to combine it with a talking head video.

By the end, you’ll know how to use Claude AI to create motion graphics, animated titles, charts, timelines, icons, process diagrams, and product visuals without building every animation manually.

Host: Kevin
title: How to Create Motion Graphics with Claude AI
